question: Which divine form named Prāsāda is invoked to protect the head at all times?
premises: The sacred syllable om is invoked
Protection of the head is requested
Sadāśiva named Prāsāda is the protector
inference: Sadāśiva, known as Prāsāda, is invoked to always protect the head.
plain_english: Om. May Sadāśiva, known as Prāsāda, always protect my head.
